# Chunk-size calibration tables (generated by tools/chunkcal.py report; logs /mnt/tt-data/ssinghal/dsv4-logs/pf_chunkcal_*)
Setup: 40 layers, Engram on, traced chunk prefill, prefill-only, fixed chunk C = budget/U (DSV41_CHUNK_FIXED=1), chunk trace sized once for a 64k context (DSV41_PREFILL_SPAD_MAX=65536), build max_seq_len 70000, bf16 pool (fp8 for B=64), no warm-up run (replay s = total_replay_loop excludes the capture; TTFT includes compile+capture). ms/row-token = replay / (chunks x U x C). Rows of one process share the build and the host (same-process paired); across processes hosts differ by up to ~10%. 'first tok' compares each run with the current default budget of the same ISL (4096 if ISL<=16k and U<=4 else 2048).
